evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly into details collection without surfacing concerns.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by the customer, so n/a.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Never addressed. Rep quoted October 27 deadline but did not mention Value Days or date flexibility for pricing.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rep never asked for the business. Call ended with 'No problem ma'am, will there be anything else?' after providing estimate. No rate lock, no confirmation of booking, no explicit ask.

top_strength: Jevic quickly gathered the essential logistics (origin/destination zip codes, moving date, item description and approximate weight) and provided a concrete estimate range ($2,000–$2,208) in a short timeframe.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire Einstein framework: no quid pro quo framing, no two-concerns question, no promises, no value days discussion, and crucially, no ask for the business—rep ended by saying goodbye instead of closing for a date.
